title: Large-desk rendering, navigation, and persistence contract
invariants: Assistant prose streaming does not rerender the whole app shell or unrelated sidebar rows; visible status and tool changes still update.
Project, parent, worker, archived, and linked-chat views derive from one pass over sessions rather than a full rescan per row.
Completed transcript turns retain object identity while only the live tail rebuilds; model path context remains bounded.
Long transcripts paint in scheduled batches and remain pinned to the latest turn until the requested history is visible.
Media decode and large file diffs paint in bounded animation-frame batches without blocking chat navigation.
Search handles the declared corpus without spread-argument overflow and returns the newest matching timestamp.
Draft typing stays local until a normal flush boundary; state is compact and full recovery backups rotate on their own interval rather than every journal save.
A restart preserves session identity, parent nesting, selected chat, goal and worker state, attachments, and the newest durable message without duplicate dispatch.
